a4

## Reasoning

**(1) Investigation:** I traced the history of `RemoveVmCommand.java` around the `failedRemoveCinderDisks` variable using
`git log -S"failedRemoveCinderDisks"` (pickaxe search), which finds the commit that introduced the string. This returned a single commit: `1bfc9d0cc2e5e3a61fe3985d
74b44efc6d6366a4` ("core: Support remove of VM with Cinder disks"), which also appears in the recent commit log provided in the init

ial context — one commit prior to the fix (`ae33192d31`) in the log.

**(2) Specific bug:** In commit `1bfc9d0
side the `try` block. If `future.get()` throws (the very case the `catch` block is meant to handle), `failedRemoveCinderDisks` is still `null` when `.addAll(...)` is inv

oked on it, causing a guaranteed `NullPointerException`.

**(3) Evidence:** The fix commit `ae33192d31` changes exactly this line, from `failedRemoveCinderDisks.add
All(cinderDisks);` to `failedRemoveCinderDisks = cinderDisks;`, which avoids calling a method on the null reference. `git blame`/pickaxe confirms this
line, along with the variable's `null` initialization, was introduced together in `1bfc9d0cc` and untouched until the fix — no other commit modified this code path in

between.

I'm confident in this attribution since the introducing and fixing commits touch the exact same line/variable with no intervening changes.
